notes.text: The stored William Davidson Edition of Berakhot 63a explicitly has Chizkiyah son of Rabbi Parnakh reporting Rabbi Yochanan. This supports the two title expansions and reporting direction for this occurrence. Chizkiyah remains untitled, and no saying is imported.
